overview_description.description:
Papa is a platform that connects college students to senior citizens for companionship and assistance. The platform connects college and nursing students to older adults who need assistance with transportation, house chores, technology lessons, and other services that enable older adults to stay independent while living securely and happily at home.

Papa was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, Florida.

about_short_description.short_description: Papa is a platform that connects college students to senior citizens for companionship and assistance.

product.name: Papa Companion Care
product.description: In-person or phone-based companionship and practical support delivered by vetted Papa Pals to eligible older adults, underserved populations, and families.

product.name: The Papa Platform
product.description: A technology and operations platform for scheduling, delivering, monitoring, and reporting human-centered social care services through a national Papa Pal network.

product.name: Papa Plus
product.description: An in-home support service for health plans that combines companion care with structured engagement pathways for quality, utilization, and care-management objectives.

product.name: Flexible Family Care
product.description: An employer-sponsored companion caregiving benefit that helps employees support aging or ill relatives, children, and themselves with in-person or remote assistance.

product.name: Post-Discharge Support
product.description: A health plan service that provides companion support after hospitalization to help members recover at home, follow discharge plans, and reduce avoidable readmissions.

product.name: Care Gap Closure
product.description: An in-home support service that helps health plan members complete preventive and chronic-care activities through scheduling, transportation, encouragement, and follow-through.
